intent: Technical Brief: Asus Zenbook Duo Pro UX582LR Power Supply Issues
detected_fault: Power supply issues, including shutting down on AC power and not charging with a new battery
suggested_solution: Check for BIOS updates and install the latest version
Run a diagnostic test on the laptop's PSU using specialized software or tools
Inspect the charging circuitry within the PSU for any signs of damage or wear
Consider replacing the PSU if the issue persists after further investigation
